events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place on this day in 1969, defining a generation.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley, who left us far too soon in 1977. The King would have been 91. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! From Akron to the top of the charts with The Pretenders, what’s your favourite track from this rock icon?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: You know the voice, you know the attitude. Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to imagine a world of peace. The enduring power of 'Imagine' is undeniable. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Remember The iPod
angles.copy: 25 years ago today, Apple dropped the first iPod. Suddenly, '1,000 songs in your pocket' became a reality. What was your first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to legendary theme tunes, who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond movie?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the indelible mark John Lennon left on music and the world. What's your favourite Lennon song, solo or with The Beatles?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from this comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that broke new ground. What tracks stand out most to you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago. The world would be celebrating his 80th birthday. His legacy, however, lives on. What's your favourite Queen song?
